scope: Bounded outcome-exposed later-evidence research across every included manufacturing group. Source dates are publisher labels as reviewed, not proof of historical availability. This research ledger is not admissible primary outcome evidence; source bodies for leads are not pinned here. Retained NIST archive positions refer to the separate exact-byte 2024 or 2025 packets, not new source acquisition.
search_scope: Three collaborators each reverified the frozen population and searched all assigned groups: original positions 12-33 (9 groups), 34-55 (13), 56-76 (23). Sources included all matching retained NIST narratives and targeted official NIST/Commerce, state/local government and permitted issuer searches. Intel/GF issuer and SEC routes excluded; X-Fab issuer access excluded. Access failures and rights restrictions were not bypassed. Search silence and mutable-directory omissions are not negative evidence.
limitations: Manual, outcome-exposed screening; not independent or blind and no claim of exhaustive search recall.
Unretained leads require exact source/policy review, successful capture where permitted, semantic correspondence review and separate admission before use as outcomes.
Two projects can share one source event; component attainment is not whole-project attainment.
Paused, cancelled, complete, operating and new guidance are distinct; no machine outcome labels or forecast scores are produced.
The restricted IEDC guidance lead predates the prospective September freeze. Preserve the old vintage and disclose coverage gaps rather than backfilling knowledge.
